excerpts: [Maximum](https://maximum.com/) [Request access](https://maximum.com/) maximum.com/privacy Privacy Policy Last updated August 27, 2026 Introduction Maximum Technologies, Inc. (“Maximum”) understands and respects your privacy and is committed to protecting any personal information shared with us. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, secure, and where applicable, share information when you visit www.maximum.com and any of our other websites (collectively, the “Website”), and summarizes your privacy rights. Scope Given the nature of Maximum’s business and the customers we work with, the Privacy Policy may be applied differently depending on your interactions with Maximum and the Website. The scope of the Privacy Policy is dependent on the role Maximum plays in each instance. It’s important to define two key terms to better understand which party is responsible for making the decisions about your data that may be shared. A **Data Controller/Business** is the party that decides what information gets collected and what happens to it. A **Service Provider/Data Processor** is a third-party (in this case, Maximum) who is hired to handle information on someone else’s behalf and only does what that other party (in this case, your financial institution) instructs. For all Website visitors, the Privacy Policy applies to information collected through the Website and any related marketing communications. In this instance, Maximum is acting as a Data Controller/Business. If you are the customer of a financial institution that is a customer of Maximum and uses our software, then your privacy rights are subject to your financial institution’s privacy policy and related procedures and standards. Given your relationship is with your financial institution and not Maximum, this Privacy Policy does not apply to the information you share with your financial institution. In that instance, Maximum is acting as a Service Provider/Data Processor. Your financial institution is the Data Controller/Business. It is important to note that when Maximum acts as a Service Provider/Data Processor for your financial institution, we are unable to process your data rights requests. As noted above, since your data is held by your financial institution, only they can fulfill your request. In such cases, please contact the financial institution where the account or data in question is maintained. There are instances where you may access Maximum content through third-party platforms such as social networking sites. This Privacy Policy does not apply to information collected on those platforms. If you have any questions about how your data is handled by those platforms, you will have to consult their respective privacy policies. In the event that we receive any of your data from a third-party, this Privacy Policy will then apply to your data. Overview of Maximum’s Privacy Policy Personal information collected Identification information such as name and email Device/IP data Online or network activity Geographical location data Professional or company information Reasons we may collect your data In order to provide you with content related to Maximum’s products and services Site and network security Performance and market analytics Legal & regulatory compliance Solicitation and sale of Maximum products and services When we may share your data From time to time, we may share your data with service providers and affiliates of ours. We do not sell your personal information for money. In some states, the law includes the use of cookies and related technologies for analytics in their definition of “sale” or “sharing” — and in those cases, you may opt out. See Your Privacy Options below. Your rights Depending on your state of residence, you may have the right to access, delete, correct or transfer your personal information. You may also have the right to opt out of certain types of data processing. Your Privacy Rights Various state privacy laws provide different rights regarding your information and data. Below is a list of specific rights that may be available to you, but keep in mind that the rights that you can exercise will depend on your state of residence. |Privacy Right |This gives you the right to… | |Right to Know/Access |Request a copy of the specific personal information we have collected from you | |Right to Delete |Request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal exceptions, such as subpoenas and other legal and regulatory requirements) | |Right to Correct |Request correction of inaccurate personal information | |Right to Data Portability |Request a copy of your personal information in a format that is portable and readily usable, if technically possible | |Right to Opt-Out of Sale, Sharing, and Targeted Advertising |Opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information, including targeted advertising. For further information, see the “Your Privacy Options” section. | |Right to Opt-Out of Profiling |Where your state’s law allows, you may opt out of automated decision-making that may significantly affect you — for example, decisions about credit, employment, or other essential services. | |Right to Non-Discrimination |We will not penalize you for exercising any of these rights. | How to Exercise your Rights When Maximum acts as a Data Controller/Business, you can submit a data rights request directly to Maximum at [privacy@maximum.com](mailto:privacy@maximum.com) . Response Timing and Verification Once we verify your request, we strive to respond within 30 business days of receiving your verified request. If more time is required, we will let you know why, and how much longer we need to respond to your request. Please note that we must verify your identity before we can act upon your request. To process your request, we must be able to match your identifying information, such as your name and email address, to our records. There may be instances where we require additional information to confirm your identity. If another party is acting on your behalf, we will need written legal authorization clearly indicating that that party is duly authorized to act on your behalf. If we deem it necessary to deny your request, you have the right to appeal by contacting us at [privacy@maximum.com](mailto:privacy@maximum.com) . The appeal must be made within 30 business days from the date of our decision. As a reminder, in the instances where we are acting as a Service Provider/Data Processor for your financial institution, we will not be able to process any data rights requests from you. Contact your financial institution with any and all such requests. Information We Collect When interacting with Maximum through the Website, the information you provide may include: **Personal Identifiers** — These include your name, email, address and phone number **Professional Information** — This may include your company name and job title **Communications** — There may be instances where you provide us with feedback, or submit a request for technical or product support **Job Application Information** — If you apply for a role listed on the Website, this includes the position named in your application, your name and email address, your resume, and any other information you send to [careers@maximum.com](mailto:careers@maximum.com) **IMPORTANT NOTE:** We do not collect sensitive personal information (e.g. Social Security Number, biometrics, etc.) through the Website. We will never ask you for such information through the Website and you should never provide sensitive personal information through the Website via any method. Information Collected Automatically Within the Website, we use standard cookies and other tracking technologies. In doing so, we may collect device data such as IP address, browser type, operating system and device type. We may also collect information about your usage of the Website that includes the pages you visited, how much time you spent on those pages, and the URL of any site that referred you to our page. We may also collect general location information based on IP address. How We Use Your Information In instances where we do use your personal information, we will only use it for the following business purposes: To provide you with content, documents or product information you requested To monitor Website traffic, ensure the security of the Website and prevent fraud To market our products and services (with your consent, where required) To analyze Website usage so that we may better engage with our audience and improve the overall user experience and interface To assess your application if you apply for a role with us, to contact you about it, and to consider you for other roles where you have asked us to From time to time, we will need to comply with subpoenas, court orders, regulatory requirements and requests and other mandatory requests. Please note that we only retain personal information for the amount of time that it is reasonably necessary to fulfill the business purposes for which it was collected and to satisfy legal, regulatory, accounting or other requirements. Job applications are retained for up to 12 months from the date you apply, after which they are deleted. If we hire you, your application becomes part of your employment record and is retained under our employee data practices instead. You can ask us to delete your application at any time by emailing [privacy@maximum.com](mailto:privacy@maximum.com) . How We Share Your Information Below are the circumstances in which we may share information: Maximum works with third-party service providers who, among other things, host the Website, communicate with existing and prospective customers, host our data environment and provide other services. It’s important to note that each and every one of these third-parties is legally and contractually required to keep all information and data strictly confidential. Maximum may share information with subsidiaries and affiliates for internal business purposes, such as accounting, marketing and sales opportunities and other administrative purposes. If Maximum receives a subpoena or court order, it is legally required to provide responsive information to the requesting authority. If Maximum engages in corporate activity such as a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, the transfer of data and information may be required. Cookies and Tracking Technologies As is the case with almost all websites, the Website uses cookies to enhance your user experience and functionality. There are two types of cookies. **Essential Cookies** are necessary for the website to function in all instances. You are not able to opt out of Essential Cookies. **Analytics/Marketing Cookies** are cookies that are used to analyze performance and deliver advertising. These are considered Non-Essential Cookies. You are able to manage these cookies through the Cookie Preferences option within the Website and in your browser’s settings. Your Privacy Options You may opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information, to the extent that we ever do so. You can opt out by emailing [privacy@maximum.com](mailto:privacy@maximum.com) . We recognize opt-out preference signals, including the Global Privacy Control (GPC). When we detect a GPC signal from your browser or device, we treat it as a valid request to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information and of cross-context behavioral advertising for that browser or device. Because these signals operate at the browser or device level and may not be linked to any account, you may need to enable the signal separately on each browser and device you use, and you may need to re-enable it if you clear your cookies. Security We use industry-standard physical, technical, and administrative safeguards (such as encryption and firewalls) to protect your personal information. However, it is important to note that despite our best efforts, no method of transmitting information over the internet is completely secure. Children’s Privacy The Website and Maximum’s activities are exclusively intended for business and institutional use and is not intended for children under the age of 18. We never knowingly collect personal information from children. Any information inadvertently collected will be deleted. California Privacy Notice Maximum does not currently meet the thresholds that make it a “business” subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) with respect to information collected through the Website. If that changes, we will update this Policy and provide the disclosures and rights the CCPA requires. Where Maximum processes personal information on behalf of a financial institution, that institution is the “business” under the CCPA and is responsible for responding to consumer-rights requests. Changes to the Privacy Policy The Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make changes, we will revise the “Last Updated” date at the top of this Privacy Policy. As with all of Maximum’s terms, notices and disclosures, we encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically. Each use of the Website constitutes your acceptance of the Privacy Policy in effect at the time. excerpts: Department All departments Engineering Senior Staff Software Engineer Location: Remote (US or Canada) Maximum is building a core banking platform. Not a layer on top of a legacy core: the ledger, product, payments, card and compliance systems a bank actually runs on. You would be involved in many big design decisions from day one. It also means correctness sits with you. You would own a domain service outright: its schema, its API, its workflows, its tests. When a change touches twelve other services, you follow it into all twelve. We use AI coding agents heavily, and directing them is part of the job. Responsibilities Own a domain service end to end: schema, gRPC API, workflows, event consumers, tests, and the docs that explain why you built it the way you did. Design tables and queries in our schema DSL. Write workflows that survive partial failure: replay-safe, idempotent, and resumable from the step that broke. Test against real environments in containers. Mocking is a last resort, and we will ask why you needed it. Review pull requests from humans and from agents, with the same suspicion for both. Turn messy external inputs into a data model that holds: a vendor file spec, a regulation, a feature or integration. Qualifications Several years shipping backend services in a statically typed language. Go preferred; strong experience in Java, C#, Rust or TypeScript is also welcome. Real SQL experience: transactions, isolation levels, query plans, indexing, and migrations that run against tables with data already in them. You have debugged a distributed system in anger. You know what idempotency, at-least-once delivery and out-of-order messages do to a design. A testing habit, and an argument for why you test against real dependencies rather than mocks. You can read an unfamiliar spec, ask the two questions that matter, and start building without waiting for perfect requirements. You use AI coding agents seriously and know when to throw away what they give you. Banking, payments, ledger, card or ACH experience helps. We can teach the domain; we would rather hire for judgment.
